disclaimer: All 40 rows are fictional, generated personas for watching a demo. They are not human participants, usability evidence, security validation or market research. Do not copy them into evidence/private or report them as observed results.
interpretation_note: The project calls this cohort SME Finance Copilot. The user's 'SEM' wording was interpreted as SME; semantic-screening evaluation is a separate technical artifact.

sme.title: SME finance copilot survey — 20 fictional viewers

survey_questions.prompt: Can Shapla pay salaries on 31 October while keeping its reserve?
Which customer is most important to the current cash risk, and why?

Inspect a pasted supplier message and keep legitimate fields as a draft only.
